title: The Whiteout
text: Snow so thick you cannot see the Scion in front of you, a wall of white on every side. The wind is a scream, and sometimes it sounds like voices calling your names from the wrong direction.

options.label: Dig in and wait it out, and do not answer the voices.

outcomes.text: A cold night in a snow cave, with the voices calling outside.

options.label: The toughest leads on by compass, and trusts the needle over their ears.

outcomes.text: In circles, and then over an edge.

options.label: Call out to stay together, so no one wanders off.

outcomes.text: Something else calls back, from close by.
